prompt:
WEAPON: Ballgame Yoke of the Hero Twins (쌍둥이의 공놀이 허리띠), the armor of Americas myth, wielded in legend by 익스발란케. Legend: 영웅 쌍둥이가 지하 세계 시발바의 신들과 목숨을 걸고 공놀이를 할 때 허리에 두른 공 받이. 이긴 뒤 둘은 해와 달이 되었다.

WEAPON LOOK (materials and colors; shape; motifs): carved stone ballgame yoke worn at the waist with jaguar-pelt padding and jade plaques, jade green, jaguar gold and rubber black; heavy and curved; a bouncing rubber ball, jaguar spots and a skull ballcourt.

STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art, painterly and semi-realistic: a face modelled in soft 3D shading on nose, cheekbones, lips and jaw, soft-coloured contours instead of dark ink lines, crisp costume and weapon detail, a vivid readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting. Not flat cel-shaded 2D anime, not a chibi or moe face, not photoreal.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Ballgame Yoke of the Hero Twins as her motif — the weapon reimagined as an armored woman: plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She WEARS it at her waist at full scale, the centerpiece of her design; no shield, nothing in her hands. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that also works as this character’s card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, no foreground occlusion, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Default stance is a standing, regal, card-ready pose; motion, effects and environment may be dramatic while her design stays fully readable.

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
BASE — Facial ethnicity: Indigenous Latin American.
FACE — Eye color: gold.
HAIR — Hair color: green, independent of ethnicity.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering on banners or walls, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs, no limb replaced by a weapon or a blade.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.
